pin_title: 6 Halloween Movie Night In Essentials Under £25 UK Homes Love
pin_title_alt: 3 Snuggly Buys for a Candlelit Halloween Film Night on the Sofa
pin_hook: Blankets, glow and fluffy socks for a spooky night in
pin_description: Planning a Halloween movie night in? These highly rated buys under £25 set the mood: a spooky ghost fleece throw, flameless LED tea lights that are safe inside carved pumpkins, autumn scented candles, fluffy bed socks and orange flameless candles. Easy cosy Halloween ideas for UK homes and families. #ad #halloweennight #halloweendecor #cosynightin #ukdeals
intro: Not everyone wants to be out trick-or-treating - sometimes the best Halloween is a scary film, the lights down low and a blanket on the sofa. Here are six well-loved buys to make your spooky night in feel extra cosy.

products.name: Bedlam Halloween Fleecy Throw - Spooky Ghosts, Grey, 120 x 150cm
products.headline: A soft, spooky blanket for scary film night
products.why: A cute grey fleece covered in little ghosts that's just the right size for snuggling on the sofa. It's festive enough for Halloween without being too scary for the kids.

products.name: 50 Pack Flameless LED Tea Light Candles, Flickering, Battery Operated
products.headline: Safe glow for jack-o'-lanterns and windowsills
products.why: A big pack of realistic flickering tea lights that you can pop inside carved pumpkins with no open flame. Leftovers will come in handy for Christmas too.

products.name: YINUO Light Autumn Candles Set, 6 x 100g Scented Candles
products.headline: Six autumn scents to fill the house
products.why: A set of six scented candles in warm autumn fragrances, so you can light a different one each evening. It's also a handy gift to keep in the cupboard.

products.name: Toes Home Fluffy Bed Socks Womens, Warm Fuzzy Socks
products.headline: Toasty toes for a long film night
products.why: Thick, fuzzy socks that are perfect for curling up on chilly October evenings. A multipack means there's a pair to share.

products.name: Homemory Outdoor Waterproof Flameless Candles, Orange, Set of 3
products.headline: Pumpkin-orange glow, indoors or out
products.why: Three orange pillar candles with a flickering LED glow that suit Halloween perfectly. They're waterproof, so they work on the doorstep as well as the mantelpiece.

products.name: 12 Pack LED Tea Lights, Warm Yellow Light, Orange Base
products.headline: Little orange lights for spooky corners
products.why: A smaller, budget-friendly pack of LED tea lights with orange bases that suit the Halloween colour scheme. Dot them along shelves or inside lanterns for instant atmosphere.
